culprit_citations.quoted_text: evidence_cli overview reports filing accession 0001193125-26-114266, while the C006 artifact rows 283898-283908 have accession_number value blank.
State Street Institutional U.S. Government Money Market Fund | 7-Day Yield 3.74 % | $ 13,450 | $ 13,450 | $ 13,450 | (14)(15)

findings.detail: Filing-derived BDC rows for this report lost the filing accession even though the raw source bundle identifies accession 0001193125-26-114266.

rationale: C006 requires source traceability for filing-derived BDC/HTML rows. The raw source is readable and identifies the filing accession as 0001193125-26-114266; the flagged rows for the same CIK/report_date have blank accession_number. Because the accession is known from the raw source metadata and should be propagated to those rows, the blank stored value is a real metadata extraction/propagation error, not a false alarm.
